description: Source code for the OpenAIChatService class implementing a chat service interface to communicate with the OpenAI API, including error handling, message sending, and response parsing.

classes.name: ChatGPTError
classes.description: Enum representing different error types from the OpenAI API.

classes.name: ChatGPTException
classes.description: Exception class wrapping ChatGPTError with optional detailed message.

classes.name: OpenAIChatService
classes.description: Service class to send messages to and receive responses from the OpenAI API, implementing ChatService.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a list of ChatMessage objects to OpenAI and returns the assistant's response as a string.

methods.name: _extractOpenAIErrorDetail
methods.description: Extracts detailed error message from the HTTP response when OpenAI API indicates an error.

methods.name: _extractTextFromResponsesOutput
methods.description: Extracts output text from the Responses API response structure.

methods.name: _extractTextFromChatCompletions
methods.description: Extracts message content from a chat completion response shape.
